contexts.label: Writing / editor
contexts.safe_next: Review priors, alternatives and one proposed edit

contexts.label: Code / tests
contexts.safe_next: Surface a failing test or a bounded next test

contexts.label: File / rich media
contexts.safe_next: Inspect explicit source pointer, hash, rights and destination

contexts.label: Research / browsing
contexts.safe_next: Find attribution, contrary evidence and unknowns

contexts.label: CoMap / CoOrb
contexts.safe_next: Expand the selected typed edge and its evidence class

contexts.label: Device / CoBar
contexts.safe_next: Inspect real heartbeat, lease, recovery and freshness

contexts.label: Outreach / mail
contexts.safe_next: Prepare a draft and qualified recipient list, never send

contexts.label: Plan / calendar
contexts.safe_next: Inspect commitments and proposed bounded reminders

contexts.label: Theory / cultural / G_d / ET
contexts.safe_next: Separate metaphor, hypothesis, counterexample and measurable test

contexts.label: Password / payment / private form
contexts.safe_next: Unavailable here: no inspection or capture

contexts.label: Unknown / inaccessible surface
contexts.safe_next: Do not infer context; offer Cancel only

lenses.label: Direct reading
lenses.meaning: Read one scoped candidate edge, without asserting that it exists.

lenses.label: Converse ↔
lenses.meaning: Swap endpoints and use the predicate converse. Not reverse causation.

lenses.label: Logical negation ¬
lenses.meaning: Propose a separately testable negation; absent proof does not support it.

lenses.label: Scoped complement ∁
lenses.meaning: Defined only with a declared universe and closed-world scope.

lenses.label: Counterfactual ◇
lenses.meaning: Model if-not; always hypothetical unless tested.

lenses.label: Causal challenge ?
lenses.meaning: Seek intervention, confounders, temporal ordering and alternatives.

lenses.label: Provenance ↗
lenses.meaning: Trace source, lineage, time, observation and exact hashes.

lenses.label: Rights & externalities ⚖
lenses.meaning: Who benefits, bears costs, consents, objects and may opt out?

lenses.label: Temporal Δ
lenses.meaning: Separate observed time, valid time, future projection and stale evidence.

lenses.label: Failure & negative space ⊗
lenses.meaning: Expose blocked, unobserved, missing and failed alternatives.

lenses.label: Undo/recovery ⟳
lenses.meaning: Verify exact pre-state and replay path before claiming reversibility.

lenses.label: Multiple surfaces ◈
lenses.meaning: Present the same source identity via CoMap, CoOrb, CoBar and accessible text.

questions.label: What?
questions.template: What precisely is the candidate relation, and what is its type?

questions.label: Who?
questions.template: Who asserted it, benefits, is affected, or may object?

questions.label: Where?
questions.template: Which source, device, repository, scope or receiver holds the evidence?

questions.label: When?
questions.template: When was it observed, valid, revised, and last independently read?

questions.label: Why?
questions.template: What explanation, objective or justification is offered, and by whom?

questions.label: How?
questions.template: What mechanism and permitted steps would establish it?

questions.label: Which alternative?
questions.template: Which competing explanation or plan survives stronger tests?

questions.label: Why not?
questions.template: What prohibition, counterexample, failure or negative result blocks it?

questions.label: For whom?
questions.template: Who gains, loses, bears externalities or has not consented?

questions.label: How much?
questions.template: What units, uncertainty, resource budget, latency and cost apply?

questions.label: Disprove it?
questions.template: What observation or experiment could falsify the claim?

questions.label: What is missing?
questions.template: Which unknown, inaccessible, stale or intentionally private relation matters?

questions.label: How recover?
questions.template: What exact receipt, rollback and independent readback would restore state?

questions.label: Next CoDeed?
questions.template: What is the smallest authorized, reversible, observable next step?

questions.label: Wherefore / to what end?
questions.template: What purpose, value, or desired outcome justifies this relation, and who chose it?

questions.label: What else / outside the frame?
questions.template: What unconsidered entities, substrates, observers, missing alternatives or inverse questions deserve a bounded test?

questions.label: @ Who receives or reviews?
questions.template: Which responsible owner, permissioned receiver, independent reviewer, and exact readproof would apply?

anti_relations.rail: Not observing is not establishing no relation.
Reverse causality requires its own independent test.
Only relative to a defined universe.
Both could occur; reconcile applicability and time.
No observation of consent is UNKNOWN, not withheld.
Sending does not establish recipient readback.
Effects may be simultaneous for different stakeholders.
Static tests do not prove physical runtime.
Rollback claims require independent verified restore.
Symbolic meaning is not empirical evidence.

epistemic_separation.spiritual_or_G_d: symbolic/philosophical hypothesis; no physical or supernatural proof inferred
epistemic_separation.ET: hypothesis requires public independently checkable evidence, not symbolic association
